FAIL: photo-render.png and all canonical views show a hunched, deeply forward-leaning torso and downward head rather than original upright stance. side.png shows a pronounced diagonal hip-to-shoulder lean and flexed knees; back.png shows strong lateral lean/shoulder distortion. The bent arm ends behind the hip and fingers visibly emerge at the front crotch/inner thigh in photo-render/front.png, an obvious hand/body intersection inconsistent with front-pocket action. Lowered visible hand is spread/open and lower than original relaxed fingers. Shoulder-to-elbow and torso directions fail even if projected wrists can align. final-state.json spine01 [68.7,-2.9,-15.7] corroborates the extreme rendered bend. Hidden pocket wrist has no demanded observed coordinate.
